世界中の多くの政府が機能せず、国民の人命を守る最低限の仕事さえしていない事が良く分かる動画ですね。日本だとゴミの分別処理が細かく、全国的に国民が守って景観の美しさを保っています。精神疾患や認知症で家の中にゴミを溜め込んだりゴミ置き場から捨ててある物を回収し、ゴミ屋敷がTVニュースになるくらいのレベルって世界的に見れば笑える問題の低さなんでしょうね。冷蔵庫にお肉と野菜があり消費期限から先に食べなきゃいけないから、今晩のご飯はアレにしようかなって悩んでる日本の生活は幸せなのかな。それもクーラーの効いた部屋で寛いで、ボーッと考えてるだけですから。
This video clearly shows that many governments around the world are not functioning properly and are not even doing the most basic job of protecting the lives of their citizens. In Japan, garbage sorting is meticulous, and citizens nationwide adhere to it, maintaining the beauty of the landscape. The fact that people with mental illness or dementia hoard garbage in their homes or that discarded items are collected from garbage dumps, to the point where hoarder houses make TV news, is probably a laughable level of problem compared to the rest of the world.
I have meat and vegetables in the refrigerator, and I have to eat them before they expire, so I'm wondering what to make for dinner tonight. Is this kind of life in Japan a happy one? Especially since I'm just relaxing in an air-conditioned room, daydreaming.
